profile: Liquidia develops and commercializes inhaled therapies for pulmonary and vascular diseases using its PRINT drug-particle technology. Its marketed product YUTREPIA is treprostinil inhalation powder approved for pulmonary arterial hypertension. The company is developing L606, an investigational extended-release treprostinil formulation for pulmonary hypertension, and studying YUTREPIA in additional conditions, including systemic sclerosis-associated Raynaud’s phenomenon.
